items.name: Critical Rolls
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: A natural 1 on a {@dice d20} is an automatic failure on attacks, ability checks, and saving throws. A natural 20 is an {@variantrule Automatic Success|DMG} whenever a {@dice d20} roll is required.

items.name: Healing Potions
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: You can drink a potion as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can also use the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to administer a healing potion to a creature within 5 feet of you, restoring Hit Points to that creature instead of yourself. If you use a {@variantrule Healing|XPHB} potion as an Action, it restores its maximum possible amount instead of requiring a roll. For example, a {@dice 2d4 + 2} potion restores 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

items.name: Flanking
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to an {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB} against a Creature in melee when a conscious, able {@variantrule Ally|XPHB} stands on the opposite side of the {@variantrule Target|XPHB}, forming a line with you and the {@variantrule Target|XPHB}.

items.name: Starting Flaw Benefit
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: When you choose a starting flaw during character creation, you gain one additional General feat.

items.name: Hit Point Gains on Level Up
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: Whenever you gain a level, choose one of the following methods for increasing your maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}:

entries.caption: Hit Point Increase Methods
rows: Roll your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} twice and use the higher result.
Roll your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}. If the result is 1, reroll it. You must use the second result, even if it is lower.
Use the fixed average from the Player's Handbook: {@dice d6} = 4, {@dice d8} = 5, {@dice d10} = 6, or {@dice d12} = 7.

items.name: Help with Death Saving Throws
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: A Creature can take the Help Action to Aid an {@variantrule Ally|XPHB}'s {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB}. The {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} applies to that one roll.

items.name: Dispelling Permanent Spells
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: Permanent effects created by casting a Spell every day for a year require a dispelling check. The DC is 20 + the level of the permanent Spell - the level of the dispelling Spell. Add the caster's {@variantrule Spellcasting|XGE} ability modifier; an abjurer of 10th level or higher also adds their Proficiency Bonus.

On a failure, the caster must spend 1 hour studying the effect after 21 - their Intelligence score days, unless that value is 0, in which case the hour is immediate. Each attempt reduces the DC by 1. After the tenth attempt, use DC 10 + the Spell level.

items.name: Divine Intervention 2024
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: The 2014 and 2024 versions of Divine Intervention can both be used. If either version succeeds, neither version can be used for 7 days.

When using the 2024 version, the casting time cannot exceed 1 minute. If it casts {@spell Revivify|XPHB} or {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, that Spell cannot be chosen by this feature again for one week.

items.name: Prone: Dexterity Saves
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: While {@condition Prone|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws.

items.name: Ability Score Rolling
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: If the sum of your rolled ability scores is lower than 69, you can reroll once and keep the second set, or use Point Buy instead of rolling.

items.name: Partial Long Rests
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: Outside a safe zone, a Partial {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} restores one-third of spent Hit Dice instead of one-half, recharges abilities that recharge on a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, and does not remove {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}. Characters do not gain {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} because they did not take a full {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

Spellcasters recover Spell slots with a combined level equal to half their class level, rounded up. The character regains the option to take one {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} that recharges abilities before a full {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. If that option was already available, they gain one additional {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, up to two.

items.name: Shared Initiative Blocks
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: When allies share the same {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} result, they form one {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} block. They can interleave movement, Actions, Bonus Actions, and Reactions in any order within the block without Ready actions. This also means an {@variantrule Ally|XPHB} can heal a fallen character before that character makes a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB} in the block.

items.name: Recovery from 0 Hit Points
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: When you stand up from 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by any method other than a Critical Success on a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB} or a successful {@skill Medicine|XPHB} check, you gain 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}, up to level 5.

A {@skill Medicine|XPHB} check to stabilize a Creature is usually DC 15 and requires {@dice 1d4} hours of {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} rest. Each failed attempt increases the DC by 5. If the check fails by 5 or more, the Creature makes a DC 15 Constitution {@variantrule Save|XPHB} and takes 1 Damage on a failure.

items.name: Spell Scrolls
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: To use a Spell scroll, you must be able to cast spells. The Spell does not need to be on your class Spell list, subject to the GM's reasonable judgment.

entries.name: Recovery Conditions
entries: Persistent problems such as {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}, chronic diseases, and lingering mental injuries cannot be eased by an ordinary rest in the wilderness or by forced travel. To remove these lasting penalties, a character must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in a safe shelter with all three conditions below:

items: Safety: The area is free from immediate danger because of physical barriers, vigilant guards, or magical protection.
Comfort: Clean bedding, warm meals, and basic medical care are available.
Mental rest: The characters can relax without constant fear of ambush or the pressure of forced travel.

entries.name: Examples
entries: A prosperous inn in a walled city, a consecrated temple with healers, a properly secured rebel outpost, or a ship anchored in a friendly port can qualify.
An open wilderness camp, a ship at sea, or a military camp under constant threat does not qualify.

items.name: Long-Distance Teleportation
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: {@variantrule Teleportation|XPHB} circles more than a few miles away from the traveler do not function. {@spell Teleport|XPHB} is unstable at long distance, and the GM resolves its altered parameters and mishaps.

items.name: Talent Strain
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: Talent loses 3 points of Strain instead of losing all Strain when the relevant recovery feature is used.

items.name: Heroic Inspiration
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} can be held up to 3 times, like Master {@variantrule Inspiration|DMG}. You can use it to reroll any {@dice d20} roll after rolling but before the result is known. After using it, you must use the new result, following the same principle as the Halfling's {@feat Lucky|XPHB} feature.

entries.name: Heroic Inspiration
entries: In this campaign, you can hold up to 3 points of {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}. You can spend only one Heroic Inspiration point on a single {@dice d20} roll, after rolling but before the result is known. You must use the new result. Heroic Inspiration is a narrative reward and cannot be granted in response to a roll just to enable an immediate reroll.

entries.name: Master Inspiration
entries: The GM can award Master Inspiration for work that supports the campaign, such as preparing session summaries, recalling previous events, organizing party information or campaign records, and providing logistical or creative support between sessions.

You can hold up to 3 points of Master Inspiration and transfer a point to another character at any time, even if that character already has Heroic Inspiration. A Master Inspiration point can reroll your {@dice d20} roll after rolling but before the result is known; you must use the new result. Alternatively, you can make an enemy reroll a {@dice d20} roll and choose the lower result, or create a narrative or tactical effect when the GM agrees.

entries.name: Direction and Pace
entries: Each day the party chooses a direction and a normal, fast, or slow travel pace. Normal pace covers the standard distance without modifiers. Fast pace gives every traveler -5 to passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) and gives the navigator -5 to navigation checks. Roll a {@dice d4}; on a 3 or 4, the party moves 1 additional Hex. Slow pace gives the navigator +5 to navigation, allows the party to travel stealthily where the terrain permits, and on a {@dice d4} result of 1 or 2 the party moves 1 fewer Hex.

entries.name: Additional Activities
entries: The party can perform up to two additional activities using one travel {@dice d4} roll. On a 1 or 2, the activities delay the march by 1 Hex; on a 3 or 4, they have no effect on travel pace. This roll is separate from the slow-pace roll, so a slow journey with additional activities makes both rolls.

entries.name: Chult Hexes and Water
entries: Each Hex on the Chult Map represents 10 miles. On foot at normal pace, the party covers 1 Hex {@variantrule Per Day|XPHB}. By {@item Canoe|ToA}, it covers 2 hexes {@variantrule Per Day|XPHB} on a river or lake and 1 Hex through swamp. Each character must drink at least 2 gallons of fresh water {@variantrule Per Day|XPHB}. Water from natural sources must be boiled or treated. If a character drinks too little, they make a DC 15 Constitution {@variantrule Save|XPHB} at the end of the day, with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} in Medium or Heavy Armor and -5 while traveling fast. On a failure, they gain 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}.

entries.name: Pack Animals and Mounts
entries: Companions, mounts, dinosaurs, and other creatures also need water and food according to their {@variantrule Size|XPHB}. Animals native to Chult, such as dinosaurs, can find food and water for themselves while in their natural environment.

entries.name: Gathering
entries: Gathering is an 8-hour downtime activity that can be performed once {@variantrule Per Day|XPHB} in a natural environment. Depending on the environment and the character's skills, it can provide food, raw materials, alchemical ingredients, magic components, or treasure. During the activity, the character can take only actions allowed during a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. Combat, strenuous exertion, {@variantrule Spellcasting|XGE}, or another significant interruption ends the activity without a result.

entries.caption: Gathering Types
rows: {@item Cook's Utensils|XPHB}, {@item Fishing Tackle|PHB}, {@skill Athletics|XPHB}, {@skill Perception|XPHB}, {@skill Survival|XPHB}
{@item Mason's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB}, {@skill History|XPHB}, {@skill Nature|XPHB}
{@skill Nature|XPHB}, {@skill Perception|XPHB}, {@item Cook's Utensils|XPHB}, {@item Cartographer's Tools|XPHB}, {@skill Survival|XPHB}
{@skill Investigation|XPHB}, {@item Mason's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}, {@skill Perception|XPHB}
{@item Cook's Utensils|XPHB}, {@skill Perception|XPHB}, {@skill Nature|XPHB}, {@item Weaver's Tools|XPHB}, {@skill Survival|XPHB}

entries.name: Procedure
entries: Roll {@dice 5d6} and record the results. Before calculating the final result, you can reroll a number of dice equal to the relevant ability modifier. If you have proficiency with an appropriate tool, you can reroll additional dice equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Reroll dice separately or together, but only once per activity.

Multiply the sum of the five dice by the multiplier for the final dice pattern and {@variantrule Round Down|XPHB}. Five of a Kind multiplies the sum by 3, Four of a Kind by 2.5, Full House by 2, Straight by 2.5, Three of a Kind by 1.4, Two Pair by 1.2, One Pair by 1.1, and no pattern by 1.

entries.name: Resources and Assistance
entries: You can spend resources such as {@item Rations|XPHB} or other suitable items to gain a bonus to the final result. Each resource adds +1, or more for a better resource. A proficient helper studying in the same environment grants one additional reroll, up to the helper’s Proficiency modifier. The GM can impose penalties for missing equipment, unfamiliar terrain, or severe conditions and can require a {@skill Survival|XPHB}, {@skill Nature|XPHB}, or {@skill Investigation|XPHB} check. Gathering cannot be performed at the same time as crafting, a longer rest, or training.

entries.caption: Gathering Ranks
rows: +10 to the final result and +1 reroll
+15 to the final result, +2 rerolls, and a 20% chance of an extra reward
+20 to the final result, +3 rerolls, and a 40% chance of an extra reward
+25 to the final result, +4 rerolls, two rewards, and a 60% chance of an extra reward

entries.name: Activity and Requirements
entries: Crafting is an 8-hour downtime activity that can be performed once {@variantrule Per Day|XPHB}. You need materials for the item, normally purchased for half the item’s price, and any spell access or class level required by the item. Potions are an exception and do not require spell access. Specific requirements can include tools, proficiency, a workshop, a formula, a teacher, a magical source, or a story quest. A significant interruption ends the activity without a result.

entries.caption: Crafting Types
rows: {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|XPHB} or {@item Tinker's Tools|XPHB} (Intelligence), and knowledge of the spell
{@item Smith's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB}, {@item Tinker's Tools|XPHB}, or {@item Woodcarver's Tools|XPHB} (Strength or Dexterity)

{@item Jeweler's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Painter's Supplies|XPHB}, {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|XPHB}, or {@item Weaver's Tools|XPHB} (Charisma, Dexterity, Intelligence, or Wisdom)
{@item Tinker's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Carpenter's Tools|XPHB}, or {@item Woodcarver's Tools|XPHB} (Intelligence or Dexterity)
{@item Carpenter's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Woodcarver's Tools|XPHB}, or {@item Tinker's Tools|XPHB} (Dexterity or Intelligence)
{@item Smith's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB}, or {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|XPHB} (Strength or Intelligence)
{@item Weaver's Tools|XPHB}, {@item Cobbler's Tools|XPHB}, or {@item Painter's Supplies|XPHB} (Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma)
{@item Cook's Utensils|XPHB}, {@item Herbalism Kit|XPHB}, or {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB} (Wisdom, Dexterity, or Intelligence)
Determined by the item, often a combination of tools

entries.name: Procedure
entries: Roll {@dice 5d6}. You can reroll dice equal to the modifier of the relevant ability, with additional rerolls from tool proficiency. Choose two conditions that fit the crafting situation: dangerous place -1, travel +0, safe shelter +1, no appropriate workshop +0, appropriate workshop +1, a proficient assistant +1, or a master with {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} or a narrative {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} +2. You can reroll dice separately or together, but only once per crafting activity.

Apply the final dice pattern: Five of a Kind x3, Four of a Kind x2.5, Full House x2, Straight x2.5, Three of a Kind x1.4, Two Pair x1.2, One Pair x1.1, and no pattern x1. Multiply the sum and {@variantrule Round Down|XPHB}. The Progress Points table below already includes this campaign's x2 crafting multiplier, so crafting is completed twice as quickly.

entries.name: Progress and Requirements
entries: The GM determines unique requirements for artifacts and can require previous training in a related field or approval before a character crafts armor, weapon mastery, or another advanced proficiency.

items.name: Survival in Gathering
items.subtitle: Fumble rule
entries: Add {@skill Survival|XPHB} to the example proficiencies for Water, Hunting, Desert, Forest General, and Arctic Gathering. Do not add it to Plants, Minerals, or Caverns.

entries.name: Duration and Interruption
entries: Training takes 8 hours and can be performed once {@variantrule Per Day|XPHB}. During the activity, the character can take only actions allowed during a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. Combat, {@variantrule Spellcasting|XGE}, strenuous exertion, or another significant distraction interrupts the activity and produces no result.

entries.name: Requirements
entries: The character must have a plausible way to gain the proficiency, such as a teacher, a {@item Book|XPHB}, practice on injured creatures, suitable tools, or an appropriate subject for study.

entries.name: Training Roll and Rerolls
entries: Roll {@dice 5d6}. You can reroll a number of dice equal to the modifier of the ability associated with the training. Reroll dice separately or together, but only once per training activity.

entries.caption: Training Ability
rows: The ability used by the skill
Intelligence; a language related to one you know grants +1 additional reroll
The ability used by the tool
Light or Medium: Dexterity; Heavy: Strength
Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution, chosen by the player
Strength or Dexterity, based on the dominant damage type
Strength or Dexterity, based on the dominant damage type

rows: A master with {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} or a narrative {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}

rows: Reload 100, Automatic, Burst Fire, Two-Handed, Heavy
Reload 1000, Burst Fire, Automatic, Two-Handed, Heavy
{@firearm Pneumatic Spray Flamethrower|Fumble|Pneumatic Spray or Flamethrower}

entries.caption: Explosive {@variantrule Firearms|DMG}
rows: Reload 30, Burst Fire, Automatic, Two-Handed, Heavy
Reload 30, Burst Fire, Automatic, Two-Handed, Heavy

entries.name: Grenades and Sprays
entries: Ammunition for a launcher or spray has a {@variantrule Save|XPHB} DC of 12 + the attacker's Proficiency Bonus. A grenade can also be thrown using the Utilize Action to a point within 20 feet.

Grenades include {@firearm Explosion Grenade|Fumble|Explosion} using {@spell Shatter|XPHB} for 50 gp, {@firearm Greater Explosion Grenade|Fumble|Greater Explosion} using {@spell Fireball|XPHB} with half the Damage dice converted to Thunder for 300 gp, {@firearm Smoke Grenade|Fumble|Smoke} using {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB} for 20 gp, {@firearm Flashbang Grenade|Fumble|Flashbang} using {@spell Confusion|XPHB} with a 1-round duration for 60 gp, {@firearm Gas Grenade|Fumble|Gas} using {@spell Stinking Cloud|XPHB} with a 10-minute duration for 100 gp, and {@firearm Mustard Gas Grenade|Fumble|Mustard Gas} using {@spell Cloudkill|XPHB} with a 10-minute duration for 500 gp. Sprays include {@firearm Bullet Spray|Fumble|Bullet Spray}, a 15-foot cube of {@dice 3d8} Piercing Burst Fire for 1 sp, {@firearm Fire Spray|Fumble|Fire}, which uses {@spell Burning Hands|XPHB} at 3rd level with burning targets for 20 gp, {@firearm Napalm Spray|Fumble|Napalm} for 100 gp, and {@firearm Acid Spray|Fumble|Acid} using {@spell Tasha's Caustic Brew|XPHB} for 100 gp.

entries.name: Shared Mechanics
entries: Reload allows a limited number of shots before reloading as an Action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Reload 1/4 requires four such actions, which can be spread across turns. Burst Fire uses 10 pieces of ammunition to fill a 10-foot cube. Creatures make a Dexterity {@variantrule Save|XPHB} against DC 8 + the shooter's Dexterity modifier + Proficiency Bonus; roll Damage once for each failed {@variantrule Save|XPHB}. Automatic lets the attacker make two attacks with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} instead of one, using twice the ammunition. A natural 1 on the {@dice d20} that determined an {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB} jams the firearm. Clearing the jam is an Action using Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}) with {@item Tinker's Tools|XPHB}: DC 15 for explosive and DC 20 for pneumatic weapons. If the attack roll had Advantage or Disadvantage, use the d20 that determined the result when checking for a jam.

entries.name: Ammunition and Modifications
entries: Pneumatic ammunition costs 5 gp for 100 rounds, while explosive ammunition costs 5 gp for 10 rounds and adds one Damage die, except for the sniper and repeating rifles as listed. {@firearm Firearm Scope|Fumble|A scope} extends the short range to the long range for one attack each turn. {@firearm Firearm Silencer|Fumble|A silencer} reduces the sound to 5 or 20 feet and allows a {@skill Stealth|XPHB} check as an Action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. {@firearm Firearm Bayonet|Fumble|A bayonet} deals {@dice 1d8} Piercing Damage and uses the base Weapon's Mastery, adding Reach 10 feet for long weapons. {@firearm Firearm Net Launcher|Fumble|A Net launcher} extends {@item Net|XPHB} range to 40 feet, is available only for long weapons, fires as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, and reloads as an Action.
